column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
_felix_instr_sha over a listing past 256 KB that opens with a tree at the path and then the blob prints the blob's id, quietly and with status 0, with SIGPIPE at its default
_felix_instr_sha over a listing past 256 KB that opens with a tree at the path and then the blob prints the blob's id, quietly and with status 0, with SIGPIPE ignored
_felix_instr_sha over a listing past 256 KB whose first line is the blob prints its id and a newline, writes nothing on stderr and returns 0, with SIGPIPE at its default
_felix_instr_sha over a listing past 256 KB whose first line is the blob prints its id and a newline, writes nothing on stderr and returns 0, with SIGPIPE ignored
_gt_class 3 over felix merge output past 256 KB that opens with a receipt-only block prints receipt and a newline, writes nothing on stderr and returns 0, with SIGPIPE at its default
_gt_class 3 over felix merge output past 256 KB that opens with a receipt-only block prints receipt and a newline, writes nothing on stderr and returns 0, with SIGPIPE ignored
_gt_detail over felix merge output past 256 KB whose first line is a blocker prints that line with no newline, writes nothing on stderr and returns 0, with SIGPIPE ignored
no awk in the engine or the suite's library reads a pipe and exits outside its END action, the allowance aside
